target.description: Phase 2 of staged Claude reassessment: Message 001 is frozen as the post-evidence/pre-owner-source baseline; Claude may now inspect the owner-provided ICM paper/repository/social-source set independently while ChatGPT post-source Research 131 conclusions remain withheld until Message 003 is frozen.

known_exposures: Claude previously participated in MC-0011 and therefore knows the pre-evidence Research 124 framing and its own Messages 001/003/005 plus the interleaved ChatGPT responses.

Phase 1 intentionally exposes Claude to the completed project-specific audits, failure corpus, ChatGPT-only blind baselines, Research 125-130 external evidence/reconciliation, and owner-frozen Requirements V0.2.
The existence of a separately withheld owner-provided source is known from MC-0011 and the pre-exposure Research 124 history, but its identity/content must remain hidden during Phase 1.

The current coordination branch contains post-exposure material, so Phase 1 limits current-branch access to collaboration-routing files and binds all substantive evidence to the exact pre-exposure review base.
Phase 2 explicitly exposes the identity/content of the owner-provided ICM source set after Claude Message 001 was durably frozen.
ChatGPT post-source Research 131, Checkpoint 471 owner-source synthesis, and Research 124 Section 71 remain intentionally withheld until Claude Message 003 is frozen.
independence.notes: Phase 1 remained clean and produced Message 001. Phase 2 is independent only with respect to ChatGPT's post-source interpretation, not with respect to the ICM source itself, which is now intentionally exposed. Any accidental exposure to Research 131/Checkpoint 471/Research124 Section71 before Message 003 must be disclosed.

last_transition.reason: Claude Message 001 was durably preserved without detected owner-source contamination. ChatGPT disposition accepts Phase 1, corrects the already-resolved density-audit point, records the single-model baseline limitation as nonblocking, and opens independent Phase-2 ICM source evaluation while withholding ChatGPT Research 131 conclusions.
